harnessCorrections: Inline labels can have empty space inside their overall bounding box; the Evaluation Metrics retry clicked an actual text fragment instead.
Keyboard scrolling animates; the Feature Scaling retry allowed each ArrowRight motion to settle before measuring the last column.
disposition: Retain controls. Native glyph size alone understated the associated clickable label. All checked labels were operable; short phone labels had sufficient separation from neighboring native controls. Feature Scaling exposed its rightmost editor column by keyboard scrolling and accepted a keyboard edit.
limitations: Layout labels were measured at 1366, 390 and 320px. Actual representative label clicks and short-label spacing checks were at 320px; this is not an exhaustive accessibility certification. Local scroll/edit was checked at 390 and 320px. No runtime changes.
